ns.mulighetsstudie.002: What can the site take? Analyse your project.
ns.mulighetsstudie.003: From property to a basis for decision: zoning, development alternatives, area schedule, sun and shadow and project economics, with measured and traceable figures.
ns.mulighetsstudie.004: Book a demo →Try a study
ns.mulighetsstudie.007: Walk through a study from property to report. The window has the study's eight steps, and calculates three development layouts, sun and shadow, scores and land value on a sample site.
ns.mulighetsstudie.008: Try it: press «Fortsett til eiendom» (Continue to property) in the window below
ns.mulighetsstudie.009: Mulighetsstudie: the steps on the left, the results in the middle and the three alternatives on the map
ns.mulighetsstudie.010: The demo needs JavaScript. The image shows the results with three alternatives on the sample site.
ns.mulighetsstudie.011: The demo calculates in the browser using the study's rules and default values: the geometry, the sun, the scoring model and the developer's calculation. It is simplified. Neighbours, terrain and the plan's own zones are not included, and architecture is measured more simply. The site, the plan and the provisions are made up.
ns.mulighetsstudie.015: The site is fetched from the cadastre with municipality and cadastral number (gnr/bnr). You check plan status and provisions, and the parameters for the analysis are listed with their source.
ns.mulighetsstudie.017: You draw no-build zones and buildable zones directly in the map. The setback from the site boundary is 4 m by default.
ns.mulighetsstudie.019: Three layouts on the same site: linear, a block with a courtyard and clusters around a green common space, with floor area, homes and sun score for each.
ns.mulighetsstudie.021: Architecture, target attainment, outdoor space, sun and BYA (site coverage) are weighted openly. The default weights are 50, 20, 14, 10 and 6 with a normal outdoor-space requirement, and you can adjust them.
ns.mulighetsstudie.023: The developer's calculation gives a residual land value with every assumption visible. An early-phase estimate, not a valuation.
ns.mulighetsstudie.025: The report gathers the layouts, the area schedule, sun and shadow and the economics in A3. The teaser is a short version for early dialogue.
ns.mulighetsstudie.026: For commercial property too: office, warehouse and logistics, hotel and retail have their own tracks in the study.
ns.mulighetsstudie.031: Fetch site and area from the cadastre.
ns.mulighetsstudie.032: Read the zoning provisions for BYA (site coverage), storeys and height.
ns.mulighetsstudie.033: Draw building lines and zones of special consideration (hensynssoner) in CAD.
ns.mulighetsstudie.034: Build volume studies by hand, one alternative at a time.
ns.mulighetsstudie.035: Calculate areas, sun and shadow and land value in separate tools.
ns.mulighetsstudie.039: Choose the site by cadastral number (gnr/bnr).
ns.mulighetsstudie.040: Plan and parameters are fetched, and you check them.
ns.mulighetsstudie.041: Draw what cannot be built on, directly in the map.
ns.mulighetsstudie.042: Three development layouts are built and ranked.
ns.mulighetsstudie.043: Download the A3 report and the teaser.
ns.mulighetsstudie.044: ToolsOne, with an A3 report at the end
ns.mulighetsstudie.047: See the possibilities on your project.
ns.mulighetsstudie.048: Choose a property you are already considering, and we show the development layouts on that same site. We set up Mulighetsstudie with your data and users, and the price is agreed according to what you need.
ns.mulighetsstudie._beskrivelse: Mulighetsstudie, the feasibility study for property development. What can the site take? From property to decision basis: zoning, development alternatives, area schedule, sun and shadow and project economics.
